objective: Qualify the experimental process and document citation, factual use and suitable recommendations; no causal efficacy inference in this cycle.

preparation.gate: Demonstrated overlap between buyer need and product capability; unresolved essential claims block eligibility.
preparation.prompt_rule: Buyer-realistic questions, no target brand, competitor list, page, rubric or desired answer in discovery payload. Updated question sets get a new baseline.

roles.coordinator: Informed researcher; Mooter is a possible coordinator, not a qualified blind executor yet.
roles.respondent: Independent supported surface, isolated operationally; receive frozen question only.
roles.reviewer: Score frozen answers against registered rubric; record evidence and disagreements.
roles.custodian: Prepare and hold reserved questions independently of optimizer.

waves.intervention: One approved truthful page change with before/after hashes and publication timestamp.

W2.rule: Run at fixed checkpoint if operationally eligible. Missing logs limits interpretation, not sampling.

waves.loop: Close all evidence including negatives before a separately registered next cycle. No sampling until a win.

queue_policy.sdk_retries_in_primary: disabled where controllable; undisclosed adapter retries make eligibility unresolved
queue_policy.interval_status: proposed lab guardrail, not a provider guarantee; confirm per surface in W0
queue_policy.next_action_at: No earlier than max(last_terminal_time + preregistered interval+jitter, provider retry_after/reset, operator pause_until); only if remaining wave budget permits.
queue_policy.deadline_rule: Calibrate W0 without primary questions, register per surface. Observation timeout does not imply provider timeout. Hard wave deadline still applies.
queue_policy.known_not_submitted: Slot can remain queued within original cap; log pre-submit failure.
queue_policy.submitted_or_uncertain: Never resubmit automatically; recover existing response by run identifier or manual inspection. Failed submitted slot remains failed/partial/unknown.
queue_policy.pause_exceeds_budget: Close incomplete; mark remaining slots not_started. Do not silently extend wave or replace failed slots.

failure_policy.temporary_rate_limit: Persist literal message/header; pause, honor reset, no account/model rotation.
failure_policy.spend_or_subscription_cap: Stop until legitimate reset/authorized access change; no blind backoff loop.
failure_policy.capture_failure: Recover same response; keep raw partial evidence and unknown latency.
failure_policy.authentication_or_permission: Stop; inspect supported access; do not bypass controls.
failure_policy.safety_refusal: Preserve as refusal, separately from recommendation; do not paraphrase to defeat guardrails. Reviewer adjudicates coverage.
failure_policy.condition_drift: Close condition, version a new manifest; no silent fallback or pooling.
failure_policy.content_mismatch_before_submit: Block and correct capture/input; never send a known altered prompt.

storage.integrity: Append new evidence/events, hash original captures, supersede interpretations with provenance. Hashes detect changes; they do not guarantee immutable storage.

learning.human_closeout: Required after every wave with counterevidence and next hypothesis.
learning.outcomes: Counts per intent and wave for citations, factual use and appropriate recommendations. Joint recommendation+citation remains a separate descriptive measure.
learning.missingness: Display evaluable counts plus all failures/partial/unknown slots. Retain no-search and no-citation answers.
learning.inference: No +2 efficacy rule, pooled population CI, universal sample minimum, causal attribution or sales claim.
learning.two_ledgers: Scientific observations independent from operational telemetry, linked by identifiers and hashes.
learning.holdout: Custody independent of optimizer; learning access forbidden.

inputs: GPT contradictory review of passage E

scientific_observations.new_fact_used: Require page diff and answer excerpt. A cited URL alone does not prove use of the revised fact.
scientific_observations.missingness: No automatic promotion from access to retrieval/citation/use. Null is unknown, not absence.
scientific_observations.competitor_included: Per-brand observations, descriptive comparisons only; not a causal control group.

condition_record.eligibility: Verified essential isolation/access controls and search_available=true required in the primary arm. search_used may be false/null and remains in results. Hidden backend identity may remain unknown; never claim it is frozen.
condition_record.privacy: No exact IP, credentials, cookies or unrelated memory.

partial_deferrals.6: SDK part deferred; observable UI drift recorded separately
partial_deferrals.12: Learning integration deferred; no-learning/holdout protection applies now
partial_deferrals.15: Shared-component regression mandatory if implementation touches Mooter

new_cases.19: Search available/used separated; no outcome exclusion
new_cases.20: Independent stage evidence; missing crawl does not cancel fixed W2
